publication.title: A Glyph Is Not a Letter, a Token Is Not a Word, a Space Is Not a Space: What the Units of Voynichese Are Not
publication.status: 2026-08-17 arXiv v1；原始相关章节与固定commit代码已核查，未独立重跑整篇
publication.category: 直接先例：单位、边界与生成器校准
publication.claim: 以边界、单位学习、词序和密码对照约束字母/词/空格的解释；有明文密码与自复制都能复现多项统计，单项相似不足以辨认机制。
evidence: §3.2/A.8：末字形→后词首字形关系；§3.6/A.7：段首行与其他行分开；§3.9/A.5：Naibbe与自复制对照；§3.7/A.5：合成密码校准。
固定commit的edge_order.py使用原样本plug-in互信息减去行内整词置换均值；不是训练/开发/测试预测增益。
selfcitation驱动明确标为简化Python移植；Naibbe驱动也明确未执行原仓库代码。
limitations: 是直接研究先例，不能把本轮边界/段首现象或跨机制低熵重现称首次发现。
本文生成与统计协议不等于我们作者Java实跑、严格可逆Naibbe分支、完整词归一化预测或源行条件扰动；数值不可直接并列排名。
该文Python selfcitation校准loss显式含词长、词型数和hapax三项；同seed用于选择与报告，没有独立机制验证。
reproduction_plan: 只补先例说明，不据此改变已冻结模型或reserve方案。
未来若逐项复现，另冻结作者移植版与原Java、相同清洗/单位/样本及独立评估划分；先核验已知机制，不能直接把本文负结果外推所有密码或所有复制模型。

code_audit.finding: Python simplified port; glyph tables/grammar copied from author mechanisms, token-count Voynich page/line/paragraph template, explicit unchanged-copy probability, 35% line-final rewrite; not author Java execution.
code_audit.implication: Our author-Java native-layout controls are related but not a bit-identical replication.

code_audit.finding: Loss = ((mean length−target)/.25)^2 + ((types−target)/500)^2 + ((hapax−target)/.03)^2; 4 copy probabilities × 4 replacement-multiplicity settings, same seeds for selection and reported streams; default 3 seeds.
code_audit.implication: Hapax is a fit target too, despite short prose describing length/vocabulary calibration. Do not present its tail comparison as wholly untouched validation.

code_audit.finding: Python port draws rand(100) <= p; p=28 therefore 29% at ordinary LOCALY calls and 15% at line-initial calls. It has simplified page-top fallback and no Java min(10,...) floor for low settings.
code_audit.implication: Paper shorthand .28 is a configuration description; actual branch probability and native Java intervention differ at low settings. We did not modify our frozen code.

code_audit.finding: Reimplemented from tables, no original repository code executed; stream-level respacing, v→u, 3% optional space deletion omitted; driver can compare original shipped Pliny ciphertext.
code_audit.implication: Distinct from our official-source run plus explicitly restricted strict-unique variant; neither is a historical decipherment.

code_audit.finding: All adjacent same-line pairs, full-sample empirical feature marginals and plug-in MI; shuffle whole token identities within each line 100 times, report observed−mean null and divide by target entropy. Token identity capped at 2000; edge features uncapped.
code_audit.implication: Our boundary predictors estimate fixed conditional held-out log-probability gain, with style/length/position controls and nonoverlapping pairs in the initial model. Different estimand, scale, sample, dependence and null.
